event_description: A game begins: fires once when the countdown ends and players are given control. Menu freestyle never raises it.
parameters_to_assign: ai_count game_mode intensity invite_triggered is_multiplayer match_id party_id player_count player_count_ai player_count_human player_ids vessel_class

event_description: A game ends. Carries flight time, wall-clock duration and the match grouping keys.
parameters_to_assign: ai_count duration_seconds flight_time_seconds game_mode intensity is_multiplayer match_id party_id player_count player_won timestamp_utc_iso timestamp_utc_ms vessel_class

event_description: The app was paused or quit. One per session.
The player pressed Play Again on the end-of-game scoreboard.
A tracked UI interaction, such as menu navigation or a button press.
An ad finished loading and was shown to the player.
First ever launch on this device. Fires once, guarded by a device-local flag.
The main menu became fully interactive and the player can act.
The player took manual control of the menu vessel, entering freestyle flight.
A game mode became available to the player through progression.
A new intensity tier became available for a game mode.
The player changed a setting in the options menu.
Crystals were credited to the player, from any source.
Crystals were debited from the player, for any purchase.
A purchase was attempted with an insufficient balance. The economy starvation signal.
A vessel was unlocked, whether purchased with crystals or granted.
The player's crystal balance at session end, for hoarding versus spending analysis.
The player sent a friend request to another player.
The player received a friend request from another player.
A friendship was established after a request was accepted.
The player invited another player to their party.
The player received a party invite.
The player successfully joined another player's party.
The player favorited or unfavorited a minigame.
The player used the native share sheet to share something from the game.
The player completed a quest and claimed its reward.
The player lost several games in a row. A frustration and churn-risk signal.
A Cloud Save write exhausted all retries while online. Backend health signal.
